Maybe confidence isn’t having all the answers… maybe it’s learning how to deal with not having them.

Video

People say they don’t trust journalists… 
…but most of the information online still starts with journalists. That’s the weird part. 

Watch the full episode with Katie Couric on my YouTube channel.

Video

Voting is basically buying a house you’ve never lived in… …and then finding out it’s haunted after you move in. 

Full episode with Katie Couric out now on my YouTube channel.

Video

In most countries the news gives you different perspectives. 
In America… sometimes it feels like entirely different realities. 

New episode with Katie Couric is out now on my YouTube channel.
